grades.reason: Introduces the xv6 shell and chapter overview. It says nothing about copying system-call argument strings from user memory.
Describes the user-level semantics of fork, exit, wait and exec. It mentions exec's string arguments but not how the kernel safely fetches or copies them from user memory.
Covers stati copying inode metadata into a stat structure. This is unrelated to fetching a string argument from user space.
Gives a general introduction to OS interfaces, kernel/user space and system calls. It has no information on safely copying argument strings from user memory.
